# @tinyforge/dsh-theme
English | 中文
## Summary
WJ Dreamlight is an optional Web profile bundle with eight selectable themes, matching wallpapers, p
alettes, and previews — plus a generic theme interface so more themes, including ones you define you
rself, reuse the same effect layer. VIP Golden Radiance adds gold accents, glass surfaces, a license
d display font, and light effects. The bundle and selected theme stay with the profile when DSH is u
y font, and light effects. The bundle and selected theme stay with the profile when DSH is upgraded.

## Use this package
Choose one installation method for the Web profile:
- **Official:** Open **Settings → Plugins → More → Official**, find **WJ Dreamlight**, then install

and enable it.
- **npm registry:** Run `dsh plugin --profile desktop add @tinyforge/dsh-theme@1.1.0`

.
- **From this Git repository:** Run `dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/phoen

ixlucky/dsh-theme.git#main`.
- **Local copy:** Run `dsh plugin --profile web add E:\home\dsh-theme`.
The current package id is `@tinyforge/dsh-theme` and its bundle version is `1.1.0`. The bundle suppo
rts DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.2-alpha.2`, and later stable `0.2.x` releases. Its `dsh-client-ui-theme`
dependency accepts the matching compatible releases; that dependency version is not this bundle's in
stall version. Install through `dsh plugin` so Harness records the bundle in the profile.
Open **Settings → Themes & wallpaper** — the gallery has a Settings page of its own, next to General
— to browse the eight themes and adjust separate 0–100% background-transparency sliders for the sid
ebar and conversation area. Select a card to preview its wallpaper, then choose **Apply theme** to s
witch; the theme and transparency values are saved in the `dsh-theme` plugin configuration for the c
urrent profile and restored after restart on clients that load this Web plugin. At 0%, the original
theme surfaces are preserved. Wallpaper visibility at higher values still depends on whether the hos
t canvas is transparent. The gallery also follows the host theme settings for light, dark, and syste
m, and saves whichever of the three you pick, so a restart keeps that palette instead of falling bac
k to the system setting. Enabling the bundle preserves the current theme preference, including `syst
em`; choose VIP Golden Radiance from the gallery to apply it. Disabling the bundle removes the galle
ry, its eight themes, and their assets, while the built-in light, dark, and system palettes remain a
vailable. Existing `official-vip-dream` preferences migrate to VIP Golden Radiance.
The browser plugin registers the eight themes through `ctx.theme` and adds its own `settings.section
` page — wallpaper grid, surface-transparency sliders, and the custom-theme editor — instead of a ro
w inside General. The page uses Harness configuration forms to save and restore theme and opacity se
ttings in the profile. VIP styling is applied through a disposable stylesheet effect. Wallpaper imag
es and the licensed display font ship with the bundle, so they need no network request or files from
the application installation directory.
## Add your own theme
Every wallpaper theme is declared, not hand-styled. A theme supplies two effect inputs — an accent c
olor and the light or dark surface it sits on — and the bundled stylesheet derives the glass panels,
accent borders, hover and selected states, scrollbar tint, and the wallpaper atmosphere from them.
Adding a theme therefore needs no CSS.
- **From the gallery:** open **Settings → Themes & wallpaper**, choose **Add custom theme**, and fil
l in a name, an image URL (`https://…`, `data:image/…`, or an app-relative `/…` path), an accent col
or, and whether it sits on the light or dark palette. Custom themes appear in the same grid with a *
*Custom** badge, can be edited or deleted from their preview, and are stored in the profile's `dsh-t

heme` configuration as `customThemes`.
- **From code:** append one entry to `builtInThemes` in `lib/
client.js`, or call `ctx.theme.register(createWallpaperTheme({ … }))`. The spec is `id`, `accent`, `
wallpaper`, `colorScheme`, and optional `surface`, `ink`, `overlay`, `labels`, and `extraTokens` for
raw token overrides.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The effect layer reads `--dsh-theme-accent` and `--dsh-theme-surface` from the registered tokens and
namespaces its own values as `--dsh-theme-*`, so a theme can override any derived token without tou
ching the stylesheet. Motion duration, hover lift, glass fills, borders, and the wallpaper atmospher
e stay separate tokens, and decorative motion is disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
## Supported versions
This bundle targets DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.2-alpha.2`, and later stable `0.2.x` releases whose `dsh-
client-ui-theme` exports the external theme metadata fields. A DSH release outside those ranges need
s a compatible bundle release.
## License
The wallpaper artwork is packaged under `assets/`. The GuruQiuWan display font and its Apache-2.0 no
tice are included there as well; see `font-license.txt` and `LICENSE-2.0.txt`.
